title: OL-20261112-95: Declare flows for the 53 pending loops
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** every tick while pending is non-empty
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/flows.json::"pending": \[\]
**Status:** closed

Each pending loop in doctrine/flows.json gets inflows, outflows (with via) and feedback, then leaves pending; the check fails a declared loop left on the list.

**Evidence:** python3 -m foundation flows --check: 101 declared, 101 on a feedback cycle, 0 pending; tests/foundation/test_flows.py NoPending.
